interaction_timeout_ms.description: Automatic-expiry policy for an interactive answer: positive milliseconds deliver a benign decline at the deadline; null disables automatic expiry.

primary_harness.description: Global default primary harness; null = engine decides.

eligible_harnesses.description: Harness pool eligible for routing/races; empty = all available.

env_inheritance.description: How the child harness env is built: mirror_native inherits the user's shell env; clean spawns from a minimal allowlist.

auth_preference.description: Preferred auth route: subscription (native/OAuth session), api_key (a stored API key), or auto (engine picks subscription-first with policy fallback). A preference, not a secret.

goal.description: Routing objective: pace expiring quota, choose the highest declared quality tier, or minimize incremental paid spend.

paid_fallback.description: When a route with incremental paid spend may be used.

effort.description: Cross-harness reasoning-effort level as a lowercase slug (open vocabulary, mirroring the vendor contract); adapters advertise the levels they accept per model, ordered weakest to strongest by the vendor itself, and a shared normalizer passes advertised levels through, clamps inside the vendor order, places a word the vendor order lacks by the shared preference order (none < minimal < low < medium < high < xhigh < max < ultra) onto an advertised level, and refuses words neither order places.

items.description: An exact harness, model, and effort route declared by the user.
A group of comparable exact routes at one user-declared quality level.

quality_tiers.description: Per-intent quality tiers ordered highest to lowest; no provider or benchmark priors are inferred.

paid_budget_per_run.description: Incremental-cash budget: explicitly unlimited or a finite non-negative USD cap.

estimate_usd_floor.description: USD reservation floor for later parallel race candidates, deep-scan scouts, and Council members; the Deep Scan reducer; the one-shot enveloped candidate continuation; and every paid attempt inside a Delegate child. The first ordinary top-level attempt remains unreserved.

max_retries.description: Maximum retries for a transient failure.

transient_retry.description: Bounded retry policy for adapter-declared transient failures; user-global only.

reviewer_timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock timeout for a reviewer run, in milliseconds.

harness_inactivity_timeout_ms.description: Inactivity watchdog for harness streams: no events for this window aborts the stream and fails the attempt with a typed timeout.

max_concurrent.description: Global regular-job limit across model and non-model classes, or unlimited; applied at startup.

max_concurrent_non_model_jobs.description: Regular non-model jobs admitted at once, or unlimited; applied at startup.

max_concurrent_model_operations.description: Model-operation runners admitted at once, or unlimited; applied at startup.

max_parallel_candidates.description: Active best-of candidates or deep-scan scouts within one run.

max_deep_scan_width.description: Maximum scout count in one deep scan.

max_council_members.description: Maximum distinct Council members; Council requires at least two.

runtime.description: Global runtime timeouts and retry policy.

runs_max_age_days.description: Delete terminal, unreferenced run trees older than this many days.

reviews_max_age_days.description: Delete standalone diff-review trees older than this many days.

keep_last_runs_per_project.description: The newest N runs per project always survive, regardless of age.

retention.description: Disk retention policy for engine-owned runtime artifacts.

profile_id.description: Stable user-chosen profile identifier (unique per harness).

harness_id.description: Harness family this profile belongs to.

display_name.description: Human label shown wherever the profile appears.

credential_kind.description: Binding kind for a profile: Claudexor-owned scoped vendor state, a managed OAuth secret, or a managed API-key secret; a vendor OS-user credential may remain outside that state.

isolation_locator.description: Canonical absolute path to Claudexor-owned scoped vendor state for config_dir_login bindings; null for secret-ref kinds.

secret_ref.description: Namespaced secret-store name (e.g. claude_oauth:work) for oauth_token/api_key profiles; null for config_dir_login.

created_at.description: When the profile was registered; null for hand-written config entries.

items.description: Durable non-secret named binding for one harness; credential material may live in Claudexor-owned scoped state, a managed secret store, or a platform-declared vendor/OS-user store, never in this row.

credential_profiles.description: Durable non-secret named-binding registry; credential material may live in Claudexor-owned scoped state, a managed secret store, or a platform-declared vendor/OS-user store, never in config.

enabled.description: Whether the harness participates in routing.

native_credentials_enabled.description: Whether the native/default vendor credential (the CLI login) participates in this harness's credential ladder.

default_model.description: Per-harness default model; null = the harness's own default.

effort.description: Default reasoning effort for the harness; null = harness default.

max_turns.description: Default max agent turns; null = no limit.

max_rounds.description: Default max convergence rounds; null = engine default.

limit_action.description: On a typed vendor limit: auto (kind-aware default — rotate for subscription subjects, fail for metered), fail the attempt, surface a typed ask, or rotate to the next eligible profile.

rotation_eligible.description: Priority-ordered profile ids eligible for rotation; empty = every enabled profile of this harness in registry order.

headroom_threshold.description: Preflight headroom bound: a selected profile whose active window is at/over this ratio triggers the limit action BEFORE spawn.

profile_policy.description: Typed profile-selection policy for this harness (INV-135).

tools_allow.description: Tool names allowed for this harness.

tools_deny.description: Tool names denied for this harness.

fallback_model.description: Model to fall back to on typed fallback signals; null = none.

web.description: Default web policy for this harness.

auth_preference.description: Preferred auth route: subscription (native/OAuth session), api_key (a stored API key), or auto (engine picks subscription-first with policy fallback). A preference, not a secret.

harnesses.description: Per-harness settings keyed by harness id.

GlobalConfig.description: Claudexor v3 global user config (~/.claudexor/v3/config.yaml): routing, budget, runtime, and per-harness settings.
